import numpy as np

# Data for FY 1953 to FY 1962

silver_pred = np.polyval([slope, intercept], gold)

# Calculate R²

r_squared = 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)

print(f"R² = {r_squared}")

# Also calculate using correlation coefficient method
correlation = np.corrcoef(gold, silver)[0, 1]

import math

# Data for FY 1953 to FY 1962

# From treasury_bulletin_1962_12_page_91.txt for FY 1954-1962
gold = [22462.8, 21927.0, 21677.6, 21799.1, 22622.9, 21356.2, 19704.6, 19322.2, 17550.2, 16435.2]
silver = [3814.3, 3863.1, 3922.4, 3994.5, 4116.6, 4306.0, 4414.1, 4394.5, 4346.5, 4317.4]

n = len(gold)

# Calculate means
mean_gold = sum(gold) / n
mean_silver = sum(silver) / n

# Calculate slope (beta) and intercept (alpha)
# beta = sum((xi - x_bar)(yi - y_bar)) / sum((xi - x_bar)^2)
# alpha = y_bar - beta * x_bar

numerator = 0
denominator = 0
for i in range(n):
    numerator += (gold[i] - mean_gold) * (silver[i] - mean_silver)
    denominator += (gold[i] - mean_gold) ** 2

slope = numerator / denominator
intercept = mean_silver - slope * mean_gold

print(f"Mean gold: {mean_gold}")
print(f"Mean silver: {mean_silver}")
print(f"Slope: {slope}")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept}")

# Predict silver values
silver_pred = [slope * g + intercept for g in gold]

# Calculate R²
# SSres = sum((yi - yi_pred)^2)
# SStot = sum((yi - y_bar)^2)
# R² = 1 - SSres/SStot

ss_res = 0
ss_tot = 0
for i in range(n):
    ss_res += (silver[i] - silver_pred[i]) ** 2
    ss_tot += (silver[i] - mean_silver) ** 2

r_squared = 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)

print(f"SSres: {ss_res}")
print(f"SStot: {ss_tot}")
print(f"R² = {r_squared}")
print(f"R² rounded = {round(r_squared, 2)}")

# Verify using correlation coefficient
mean_product = sum(gold[i] * silver[i] for i in range(n)) / n
covariance = mean_product - mean_gold * mean_silver
var_gold = sum((g - mean_gold) ** 2 for g in gold) / n
var_silver = sum((s - mean_silver) ** 2 for s in silver) / n
std_gold = math.sqrt(var_gold)
std_silver = math.sqrt(var_silver)
correlation = covariance / (std_gold * std_silver)
r_squared_correlation = correlation ** 2

print(f"Correlation: {correlation}")
print(f"R² via correlation: {r_squared_correlation}")
